heading: The contract file
text:
#### The contract file [LCAP.2.1.1]

A program has `realtime: true` through its dialect (the `realtime` dialect,
[LDIA.9.3]) or a `use` block line ([LDIA.2.1]).

The realtime contract (pool caps, WCET budget, agenda capacity,
etc.) lives in a sibling `<basename>.dsrt` file next to the rule
source, NOT in the `.ds` file. The compiler reads the `.dsrt` at
compile time and embeds the contract into the produced `.dsc`.

A `realtime` compile without a sibling `.dsrt` is a hard compile
error (`DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_MISSING_DSRT`). See [RTCT.4] for the
`.dsrt` file format and the authoring workflow.
